coverage.description: phi/tau/sigma/mobius require positive complete-factor inputs; divisors accepts signs, rejects zero and checks count before sorted materialization. Prime count/rank sieve is capped, next_prime unbounded. digits strips sign; from_digits accepts arbitrary Horner coefficients. Canonical restrictions are needed for inversion.
